description: This file implements IP address handling, including parsing, validation, and comparison for IPv4 and IPv6 addresses, with functions for checking routability, prefix matching, and conversions between IPv4 and IPv6 formats.

classes.name: IPAddress
classes.description: Represents an IP address, supporting IPv4 and IPv6, with methods for validation, comparison, and conversion.

classes.name: IPAddressBytes
classes.description: Encapsulates the byte representation of an IP address, with comparison and memory estimation methods.

methods.name: IPAddress::FromValue
methods.description: Creates an IPAddress object from a base::Value if it contains a valid IP literal string.

methods.name: IPAddress::FromIPLiteral
methods.description: Parses a string literal into an IPAddress object.

methods.name: IPAddress::AssignFromIPLiteral
methods.description: Assigns an IP address from a string literal, returning success status.

methods.name: IPAddress::ToString
methods.description: Converts the IPAddress to its string representation.
